name: - SHOCO
fix_description: Same reflection token vulnerability. In deliver(), add a maximum limit on tAmount. The _getCurrentSupply function has a fallback condition that can be manipulated when _rTotal is drastically reduced, causing incorrect rate calculation and enabling pair balance inflation for arbitrage.
difficulty_reasoning: This exploit is a short multi-step reflection-token price manipulation that requires understanding SHOCO’s reflection accounting, direct storage reads to derive rTotal/rExcluded, and Uniswap reserve math to size the swaps. The PoC is not very long, but it is more than a trivial access-control bug because the attacker must understand protocol-specific token mechanics and sequence the buy/deliver/sell steps correctly.
